content.v: 《专注RPG》已在Android和iOS平台上架，并支持繁体中文。韩国独立游戏开发商Turtle Soft将专注计时器与放置角色扮演玩法结合：玩家完成一整段专注时间后，才能领取角色自动战斗带来的奖励。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791776695_654386.jpg
玩家开始计时后，可以放下手机去学习、工作或运动，游戏角色会在这段时间自动战斗并推进楼层。如果中途放弃专注，本次行动就会被判定为失败，无法获得奖励。开发者希望让觉得没有时间玩游戏的学生和上班族，也能通过日常专注推进游戏。
这款游戏由Turtle Soft代表JUNG YOUNGSOO一人开发和运营。除计时与战斗外，游戏还包含装备强化、装备熟练度、宠物与符文养成，以及试炼之塔、首领突袭和公会战。
《专注RPG》还设有五人实时合作副本、全球排名和每周专注排行。

content.v: vavle曾修改了面向日本用户的Steam订户协议，写入钱包充值款在充值后6个月内未使用便会失效的条款。 这一规定是由于日本支付服务法严格的要求所致。根据当地法律，预付支付工具的发行人必须将至少一半的未用金额存入国家存款作为担保，前提是总余额超过1000万日元。外国和本土企业只有通过设定余额有效期不超过6个月的方式，才能避免巨额资金被冻结。 不过，Steam客服称，日本用户的钱包余额目前没有实际有效期，这项限制尚未执行。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791776461_258264_jpg_r.jpg
协议于2026年4月20日修改，相关条款直到10月才受到玩家社区广泛关注。部分玩家担心余额会在10月20日失效，但这是把协议修订日期当作期限起点得出的推测。条款还提到钱包界面应显示有效期限，玩家目前却未在账户中找到相应计时或提示。
日本媒体Automaton就执行情况向Steam客服询问。客服答复称，现阶段日本用户的钱包余额没有设置实际有效期，限制何时实施也尚未确定。如果未来启用余额失效机制，平台会提前通过电子邮件向账户持有人告知确切日期。

https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791776202_301878_jpg_r.jpg
五年打拼，插画师沈默挣得名声，却也被药物与酒精的麻痹拖至崩溃边缘。他的女友兼制作人林薇突然以反常的冷酷，逼迫他参与新企划《灰色视症》，并在工作室会议上用激将法逼走技术骨干顾诚。当沈默拒绝绘制猎奇场面时，林薇以激烈言辞相激，他在巨大压力下视野变灰、当场昏倒。
夜晚，沈默却在一名白衣女子的膝枕中醒来。她自称林薇，却与之前的冷酷判若两人——温柔、笨拙、甚至会害羞。她用沈默的钥匙开门、钻进他的被窝、提议去海边散心，一切仿佛回到两人热恋时期。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791776203_131746.png
但沈默的“超感知”让他捕捉到违和感：她为何有自己房子的钥匙?为何无法回答关于“她”的问题?为何在他握住她的手时，世界突然反色、响起不和谐音?突然，一切变为严酷的辩证法，他眼中的真实化作一个令人费解的谜。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791776203_771694.png
游戏中你将跟随沈默的“超感知”，一同捕捉那些令人脊背发凉的违和感——
为何无法回答关于“她”的问题?
为何握住她手的瞬间，世界猛然反色、不和谐音撕扯耳膜?
当视野被抽干色彩，一片可悲的灰在眼角荡漾，你还能相信谁是“谁”?
《灰色视症》11.27上线在即，现在就前往Steam添加愿望单吧!

content.v: 曾为2016年《毁灭战士》和《毁灭战士：永恒》创作音乐的Mick Gordon表示，如果一系列条件得到满足，他愿意立刻重返《毁灭战士》系列。他在PAX Australia接受采访时没有说明具体条件，也未宣布已参与新作或与开发团队达成合作。

Gordon还说，自己曾构想许多关于《毁灭战士》系列音乐的方向，希望有一天能够探索。目前，他参与了《战锤40K：爆矢枪2》最终首领战主题音乐的制作。

content.v: 日前国家互联网应急中心发布风险提示，监测发现，“荐片播放器”Windows端应用程序内置后门功能，目前境内已有超70万台设备感染。
据介绍，该软件可在用户不知情的情况下采集终端信息、下载运行其他程序，并接收服务端指令执行任意代码，存在终端被远程控制、个人信息泄露等安全风险。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791774723_809641.png
国家互联网应急中心分析发现，荐片播放器在提供影视播放功能的同时，还会通过注册表自启动项和系统服务保持后台运行，具备静默安装第三方软件、采集终端指纹与行为数据、篡改剪贴板内容等功能。
其内置的两条独立通信通道可定期接收并执行服务端下发的脚本，结合进程注入、内核驱动加载和内存执行能力，使服务端能够持续向终端投递和运行其他程序。
对不同版本的比对发现，该软件虽调整了通信域名、接口和加密方式，但脚本下发执行、终端信息采集、进程注入等主要恶意行为仍然存在。
监测数据显示，2026年9月15日至22日期间，境内累计有700260台设备感染该恶意软件，单日上线受控终端数量最高达到251880台。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791774736_409245.png
对此，国家互联网应急中心提醒，用户应避免通过非正规渠道下载影视播放器，安装软件时注意核对数字签名，并警惕默认勾选的捆绑安装选项。
对于疑似感染的电脑，应及时使用安全软件进行全面排查，检查并清除恶意程序。
官方特别强调，已确认感染的终端应视为受控主机，建议先进行隔离排查，再重新安装操作系统。

content.v: Fuse Games开发街机风格 竞速 游戏《星球大战：银河赛车手》时，曾用简易桌游原型测试比赛之外的奖励循环。团队希望尽快玩到这套成长系统，看看逐步升级是否有趣。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791773917_366208_jpg_r.jpg
创意总监Kieran Crimmins和首席执行官Matt Webster介绍，团队用便签、草图和骰子搭建原型，以便更快讨论玩家在各阶段的选择与回报，无须等到游戏内系统完整实现。
在这套设计中，不同赛事的奖励会变化。玩家通常能获得调校点，并将其分配给三个随机属性中的一个；奖励也可能是影响载具能力，或与特定状态效果相关的零件。完成数场比赛后，玩家可以用赢得的点数购买升级、零件或新能力。
成长系统还包含肉鸽式的跨局进度：新解锁内容会进入后续游玩的可获得池，每次游玩得到的调校点也可用于永久升级。桌游只是团队测试这套系统的原型。

items.title: Steam 周回顾：Monster Land 可疑的 PC 首秀中 Wonder Boy 的奇案
items.summary: All the interesting Steam facts for the week ending October 11.

content.v: Wonder Boy in Monster Land released in Japanese arcades in 1987 and for the Sega Master System the following year. Its success led to numerous ports, including to ZX Spectrum, Commodore 64 and Atari ST. Oddly, it never received an official PC port, though that long absence appeared to have come to an end on September 28.
Did fans rejoice? Not really.

The Steam listing for Wonderboy in Monster Land raises one immediate red flag: note the rookie error of "Wonderboy" versus Wonder Boy. The developer and publisher is Retro Maniac, whose only other Steam game is Street Hoop, or Street Slam, an old Data East arcade game from 1994.

To bring you up to speed: LAT Corp owns all IP and assets once belonging to Westone Bit Entertainment, the creators of the original Wonder Boy games. But at the same time Sega, confusingly, owns the Wonder Boy trademark. In other words: LAT Corp owns the games, Sega owns the name. Both parties would need to OK any Wonder Boy re-release bearing the Wonder Boy name.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Wo73gVgy4QvBmprPPxNJj-1920-80.jpg

While the "Wonderboy" misspelling is damning, a Wonder Boy game appearing on Steam without SEGA or LAT Corp prominently displayed isn't unusual. Wonder Boy Returns Remix, which is a "remake" of the original Wonder Boy, lists CFK Co., Ltd as developer and publisher. Not only was it officially licensed, but series creator Ryuichi Nishizawa was involved. Meanwhile, Wonder Boy: The Dragon's Trap is a thorough remake of the 1989 Master System original, developed by Lizardcube and published by Dotemu. It's also officially licensed. Each listing discloses as much in the Steam page fine print which appears under system requirements.

There's also the wider confusion around the name Wonder Boy itself, which reared its head with the release of Monster Boy and the Cursed Kingdom in 2019. Since rights to Wonder Boy games are split between LAT Corp and Sega it's necessary to get an OK from both to publish a Wonder Boy game with a Wonder Boy name. But what if you can only get the blessing of one? This dynamic was in play with Monster Boy, which is definitely, spiritually a Wonder Boy game—it had Nishizawa's handprints all over it—though publisher FDG Entertainment didn't license the Wonder Boy name from Sega, hence the name.
To confuse matters even more, the original arcade version of Wonder Boy released as Adventure Island in the United States, spawning a parallel line of unrelated follow-ups.

So what is a Wonder Boy game, then? Very few but diehards know off the top of their head, and if this new arcade "port" is illegitimate, it's probably released with full knowledge that this confusion will help it fly under the radar.

I wouldn't have thought twice about it if it weren't for the Wonder Boy Universe fan account on X, which raised the alarm on September 28. Composer on the original game, Shinichi Sakamoto, also weighed in , agreeing that the Retro Maniac port is illegitimate while pointing out that it's not available in Japan. (Sakamoto also claims it's been downloaded 10,000 times on Steam, though I don't know where he got that figure).

It turned out to be a problem that affected me directly. Apparently, it has already been downloaded 10,000 times on Steam. Yet, when accessing Steam from Japan, it doesn't show up—instead, you get a message saying, "This item is currently unavailable in your region."I am currently in the process of requesting its removal. September 29, 2026

Against my better judgement I bought and downloaded the alleged illegitimate version of Wonderboy in Monster Land, and can confirm it's simply a ROM running in the MAME arcade emulator (I've since requested a refund, which was issued promptly). The one obvious change is that a splash screen bearing the Sega logo has been removed.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ETHyN25pk4aMFykADkVDHi.jpg
The splash screen for the Retro Maniac version
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/FFZoJ3MDThzJ4dPDUqwCd4.png
The splash screen as depicted by YouTube channel Retro Fighters, playing an arcade ROM
(There's another variation depicted here , only Monster Land is in English rather than Japanese. The SEGA logo remains).

I reached out to Valve about the listing but didn't hear back. I also reached out to Sega several times but received no response. The Wonder Boy Universe X account claims the Retro Maniacs listing is "in the process of being DMCA'd by officials". Presumably they have a direct line to Sega or LAT that I don't have, because only Sega or LAT can file a DMCA. According to Valve's own documentation a DMCA complaint is processed in a maximum of 72 hours but can take longer if the situation is more complex.

Complex or not, Valve's documentation also shows what happens if your listing has a DMCA filed against it. Importantly, a public-facing notice will appear on the Steam page reading "A DMCA takedown notice has been filed on this item". That is yet to happen with Retro Maniac's listing.

This kind of thing happens a lot on mobile storefronts, especially for abandonware. But Wonder Boy in Monster Land isn't, at least strictly speaking, abandonware. I can't say I'm especially worried for Sega or LAT: it's obviously legally wrong for Retro Maniac to upload and profit from a game it didn't make or license—assuming that is the case—but Sega and LAT do themselves no favours by not having legitimate versions of Wonder Boy games easily available on Steam. Monster Lair and Monster World (but not Monster Land) used to be available as part of the SEGA Mega Drive and Genesis Classics collection, but that was removed from Steam in 2024.

Still, it's pretty funny how easily one can simply upload a rip off Wonder Boy game on Steam in 2026. A fortnight after its initial launch, Wonderboy in Monster Land is still officially available, and enthusiasts continue to wonder whether they should support it or not.

That an effortful-looking MMORPG should hit number one in its launch week is unsurprising if you've been following PC gaming for the last quarter century. Also unsurprising is that it's currently sitting on "mixed" reviews. MMOs rarely or never launch to near-unanimous customer satisfaction, and the case against Aion 2 seems to be that it's structured like a free-to-play mobile game. The monetisation is apparently deep-rooted and endlessly distracting.
(I also wonder if NCSOFT will bother employing a proper artist to replace Aion 2's AI-generated assets. Surely you've got the cash?)

It's noteworthy that Minecraft Dungeons 2 only reached number ten during its first full week on sale. It's a Minecraft game, after all. It did launch onto Xbox Games Pass, and it's probably a better performer on console, but it still feels like a humble showing for an offshoot of one of the biggest games in the world.

content.v: 2026年12月5日，上海北外滩友邦大剧院，以交响乐重返无垠苍穹。
自1995年首作问世以来，空战奇兵系列已走过三十年历程，系列以独特的空战体验、富有张力的叙事和极具辨识度的音乐，构筑起属于无数 飞行 员的天空记忆。
2026年12月5日由主办方雾瑾Production倾力策划呈现的空战奇兵三十周年纪念交响音乐会，将于上海北外滩友邦大剧院举行。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791773418_430350.png
活动KV图
本次音乐会由和音社交响乐团担纲演奏，并将由空战奇兵系列首席作曲家小林启树领衔编排交响乐谱，以现场交响乐的形式重现系列 经典 旋律，为这一跨越三十年的空战传奇献上一场特别的音乐纪念。
作为雾瑾文化旗下的IP线下展演品牌，雾瑾Production持续探索游戏、动漫等IP与现场演出之间的更多可能，致力于通过专业的内容策划与演出制作，让经典作品突破屏幕的边界，以更具沉浸感与感染力的方式与观众相遇。本次空战奇兵三十周年纪念交响音乐会，也将以音乐为纽带，连接系列三十年的创作积淀与玩家共同拥有的情感记忆。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791773419_358468_png_r.webp
《群星》十周年交响音乐会
三十年，不断深化的天空
1995年，空战奇兵首作发售，以自由翱翔、击坠敌机的爽快体验，为系列奠定了独特的飞行射击风格。随着系列不断发展，空战表现、故事叙事与音乐表达也在持续深化。音乐不再只是战斗的背景，更成为塑造角色、推动情节、烘托战场氛围的重要组成部分。
三十年来，从引擎轰鸣中的高速追击，到战局逆转时的紧张对峙，再到故事终章留下的深远余韵，空战奇兵以音乐串联起一次次出击与抉择，也让那些发生在虚拟天空中的故事拥有了更鲜明的情感重量。
随着系列最新作空战奇兵8的到来，这段跨越三十年的飞行历程也将迎来新的篇章。本次纪念音乐会将以系列经典音乐为核心，通过交响乐团的现场演绎，重新展现空战奇兵独有的空战氛围与音乐魅力。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791773419_619019_png_r.webp
空战奇兵8
小林启树领衔编排，经典旋律再现交响舞台
作为空战奇兵系列的首席作曲家，小林启树以鲜明的音乐风格与富有感染力的作品，为系列构筑了极具辨识度的听觉记忆。
本次音乐会将由小林启树领衔编排交响乐谱，让曾经伴随空中缠斗、重大任务与决战时刻的经典旋律，以全新的现场形式再度响起。铜管的恢弘、弦乐的细腻与打击乐的强劲节奏交织推进，将空战中的速度感、紧张感与戏剧张力带上交响舞台。
从蓄势待发到高速追击，从辽阔苍穹到决战时刻，熟悉的旋律将在现场重新唤醒那些关于天空、战友与使命的记忆。这不仅是一次对系列经典音乐的回顾，也是一次以现场演奏为媒介、跨越三十年时光的空中之旅。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791773423_963693.png
小林启树(左一)
知名ACG音乐社团和音社交响乐团倾情演绎
和音社是由众多优秀艺术家组成的国内知名ACG音乐社团，以专业的演奏水准、鲜明的二次元音乐特色与富有感染力的现场表现广为人知。社团由动漫钢琴演奏家“猪仔很忙”领衔，著名指挥家赵晓鸥、著名小号演奏家夏非坐镇，汇聚了众多国内外知名院校的优秀音乐家。
和音社的演出形式涵盖交响乐、管乐队、重奏、室内乐及Live乐队等，近年来持续打造精品动漫游戏音乐会，多个演出项目入选上海之春国际音乐节、MISA音乐节，致力于以专业的音乐表达连接交响艺术与年轻受众。
此次，和音社交响乐团将与雾瑾Production再度携手，以专业的现场演绎呈现空战奇兵系列音乐的丰富层次与情感张力，让经典旋律在真实的音乐厅中焕发新的生命力。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791773423_695152_png_r.webp
《群星》十周年交响音乐会-和音社交响乐团
雾瑾Production：让IP在现场拥有新的生命力
雾瑾Production是雾瑾文化旗下的IP线下展演品牌，专注于IP音乐会及多元线下展演内容的策划与呈现。
对雾瑾Production而言，IP展演不仅是内容的现场呈现，更是一次让观众重新走进作品、与共同记忆产生共鸣的机会。未来，雾瑾Production也将持续策划多样化的IP线下展演活动，以优质内容为核心，为IP注入长久活力，为观众创造更多只有亲临现场才能感受到的心动与归属。
此次空战奇兵三十周年纪念交响音乐会，正是这一理念下的一次全新呈现。借由三十周年这一重要节点，雾瑾Production希望与每一位曾经翱翔于这片天空的飞行员，共同重温那些令人难忘的旋律与时刻。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791773423_261763_png_r.webp

content.v: 开发者Sword为破解后的PS5所用模拟器PS5SX2加入了PS2实体光盘支持。这项功能出现在10月10日推出的2.01测试版中。首次插入光盘时，模拟器会将内容复制到主机存储空间，此后游戏从该副本启动，并非持续从光盘运行。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791772963_232665_jpg_r.jpg
Sword此前曾展示将PS2光盘放入PS5的画面，但表示目前只在一台初版PS5上测试过这项功能。PS5内置光驱似乎无法读取CD格式光盘，因此部分以CD发行的PS2游戏可能无法通过内置光驱使用。
当天稍晚推出的2.02版还加入了一个默认关闭的实验性选项，可尝试通过USB DVD或蓝光光驱读取PS2光盘。这一选项可能对没有内置光驱的数字版PS5有帮助。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791772968_151250_jpg_r.jpg
PS5SX2最高可将画面渲染至PS2原生分辨率的六倍，不过项目说明提醒，普通PS5运行部分游戏时难以承受这一档位。Sword还计划在另一款开发中的模拟器移植项目里加入PS3光盘支持；这仍是后续计划，并非PS5SX2现有功能。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: Gamefa一篇评论认为，艾尔登法环游戏的初见难度常被信息不足放大。玩家熟悉地图和战斗规律后，即使角色数值没有明显提高，也可能推进得更顺利。不过，作者并不认为所有挑战设计都没有问题。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791772430_742751_jpg_r.jpg
评论从《艾尔登法环》的玛莲妮亚和“约定之王”拉塔恩谈起，承认这些首领会让不少玩家多次失败。耐力消耗、敌人的高伤害，以及安全点到首领之间的距离，也会增加初次挑战的压力。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791772432_480827_jpg_r.jpg
《黑暗之魂》《血源诅咒》和《艾尔登法环》还让玩家在死亡后承担找回资源的风险，而这些资源关系到升级和购买装备。作者认为，初见时不知道敌人位置与攻击方式，不熟悉陷阱、捷径，也没掌握攻击、闪避或撤退的时机，容易让人把缺乏信息感受到的压力当成单纯的强度问题。
评论以《只狼：影逝二度》为例，说明学习格挡节奏的重要性；在《艾尔登法环》中，玩家也可以暂时改走其他路线，调整装备后再回来挑战。作者据此认为，许多关卡提供了可学习、可调整的应对方法。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791772435_517416_jpg_r.jpg
但学习并不能消除所有问题。作者指出，不理想的镜头、难以辨认的招式、较长的返程路线，以及部分失衡的遭遇，仍可能让挑战过程令人疲惫。

items.title: 研究称每天睡8小时可能真多了！死亡风险还会增高
items.summary: 最新研究：每天睡8小时可能真多了 死亡风险还会增高

content.v: 近日一份公开发布的最新睡眠医学研究成果显示，多年来被大众奉为健康准则的每天睡够8小时的标准，对不少普通人来说反而超出了实际的最优睡眠需求。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121027004643.jpg
如今越来越多人开始重视自身睡眠健康，不少人专门购置了运动手表、健康手环这类可穿戴设备，用来全天候追踪监测自己每晚的睡眠质量、深度睡眠占比等各类数据，生怕睡眠不达标影响身体状态。
可不少人戴了这类监测设备一段时间后才发现，自己就算手头没有待办事项、完全放松休息，每天的睡眠时长也总在7小时左右徘徊，距离大家公认的“8小时睡眠”及格线始终差上一点点，不少人因此反而生出了额外的睡眠焦虑，哪怕毫无睡意也要硬躺在床上熬时间凑够8小时时长。
但实际上，每天7小时左右的睡眠，或许才是真正适配绝大多数普通成年人的黄金睡眠时长。
越来越多大样本长期跟踪的医学研究都证实，每天保持7小时左右规律睡眠的人群，未来的身体衰弱风险更低，长期抗衰老的表现更好，全因死亡风险也显著低于睡眠时长更长或者更短的对照组。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610121027074214.png
那些硬逼着自己一定要睡够8小时的人，反而可能真的睡多了，多出来的无效睡眠时间不仅不会给身体带来额外增益，反而有可能拖慢正常的代谢节奏，睡醒之后更容易出现昏沉乏力的情况。

items.title: 《星球大战银河赛车》的开发者通过将其转变为棋盘游戏来测试其 Roguelite 进程系统
items.summary: "You can't know if you can feel the system until you can play the system."

content.v: Years ago, I read that Jake Solomon prototyped the Firaxis reboot of XCOM by making a simple board game version. Something rudimentary that could be played in the office on scrap paper to get ideas across and figure out where the fun would be, without having to commit. But it's surprising to hear the same idea being used for a game as different from XCOM's turn-based tactics as Star Wars Galactic Racer.

As Fuse Games' creative director Kieran Crimmins told Eurogamer , "You can't know if you can feel the system until you can play the system." And so the early prototype of this high-speed arcade racing game was indeed a board game.

"You know, modern engines are so capable that you can do a lot of it in-software," CEO Matt Webster said, "but there's still something [about that which is] not as fast as getting a written idea down. From a board game perspective, you sort of decouple yourself from a particular prototype and you're talking about moment-to-moment."

Specifically, the board game simulated Galactic Racer's progression system. Its rewards differ based on the event, but typically offer tuning points to spend on one of three random stats, and maybe a part for your speeder that will affect its abilities or grant a bonus related to a specific status effect. After several races you get to go shopping, and spend the credits you've earned on more upgrades and parts, or a whole new ability.

It's a progression system right out of a roguelite, with new unlocks added to a pool so they might appear in future runs, and each run handing out tuning points that can be used for permanent upgrades that carry over between them. Not something you expect in a racing game, and a system that presumably needed a bit of road testing to find the fun.

"There's a prototyping tool for every kind of system that you want to prototype," Crimmins said, "and the one that you pick should be the one that gets you there the quickest, and gets you to validate the emotion the quickest. So when it came to upgrades and meta progression, I can do a board game in a day. I mean, I say 'board game'. A lot of it is Post-its and a scribble and some dice. But we're trying to validate those feelings as quickly as possible. So you just pick the best tool for the moment."

《Hela：鼠鼠奇旅》是一款温馨治愈的开放世界冒险游戏，由Windup Games开发。玩家将化身可爱的小鼠，以第三人称 3D 视角探索灵感源自瑞典北境的壮丽天地，在轻松惬意的旅途中发现惊喜。游戏将于 2026 年 12 月 1 日正式发售，同步登陆 Steam 与 Epic Games Store。
https://image.gcores.com/8eed5ea2b3b83b039bffac78c42aaed3-1280-720.JPEG
《Hela：鼠鼠奇旅》讲述了一位善良女巫与她的鼠鼠助手之间的温暖故事。多年来，女巫一直用魔法守护村庄，帮助身边的居民与动物。可是有一天，女巫突然病倒，鼠鼠们决定踏上旅途寻找治愈她的方法，并在她康复之前延续她一直以来的善意，帮助那些需要帮助的人。
https://image.gcores.com/1a12154a1cad336c7e1c2ba7f51a3f4e-1280-720.png
旅途中，玩家可以运用奇妙的魔法能力，自由探索、采集资源、解开谜题、穿行于自然之间，并亲手调制魔药。游戏支持单人、本地双人分屏及最多四人的在线联机，无论独自踏上旅程，还是与好友化身鼠鼠搭档并肩冒险，都能在轻松惬意的探索中，共同发现这个世界的美好。
https://image.gcores.com/0937736a63eee84bbaa8652ce5d5838a-1280-720.png

《虚空潜者：逃出深渊》
一座被异常现象侵蚀的城市，正在一点点坠入未知的深渊。作为古董店「Balusha」的店主，你将派遣“潜者”深入其中，在怪物与陷阱环伺的异界都市中搜寻奇异遗物。《虚空潜者：逃出深渊》是一款由 STUDIO NEMO 开发的克苏鲁风的搜打撤动作 RPG，支持最多 3 人联机组队。
https://image.gcores.com/4e41443daefe7b7a0f2fc489ecb395be-1280-720.png
每一次深入深渊，都是一次风险与收益之间的抉择。你可以不断探索，寻找更珍贵的遗物，也可以及时回撤，将收获带回古董店，通过交易、制作与装备强化提升实力。随着冒险深入，更诡异的怪物、强大的 Boss 与未知区域也将接踵而至。
https://image.gcores.com/e545badca7057d1aad1ef93708ff2869-1280-720.JPEG
欢迎来到展位现场亲自体验，在“搜、打、撤”的紧张节奏中探索这座危机四伏的异界都市。《虚空潜者：逃出深渊》预计于 2027 年 Q1 正式上线。

《勇闯死人谷：暗黑之日》
1980 年的德克萨斯州，沃尔顿市在丧尸潮中失守。你要带领一群幸存者在废墟里搜刮物资、制作装备、维护避难所，并在饥饿、感染和士气波动中寻找下一条活路。由Pikpok开发的《勇闯死人谷：暗黑之日》1.0 正式版预计于 2027 年 3 月推出。
https://image.gcores.com/93691befd2aba7c08fa697a06c0fe8b6-1280-720.JPEG
https://image.gcores.com/9f6df5d83d23a98c8e579a732903cd98-1280-720.png
《勇闯死人谷：暗黑之日》不是单纯的“打丧尸”游戏，而是一场不断在风险与代价之间做出抉择的末日生存体验。玩家将在城市废墟、避难所、体育馆与化工厂等多样化地图中行动，在与丧尸的对抗与末日生存过程中，感受人与人之间的情感与羁绊，并在一次次生存挑战中见证角色的成长与变化。每一次外出与资源分配都可能改变队伍的命运，每一个决定都在考验你“让更多人活下来”的能力。
https://image.gcores.com/7cecd21ce16960171ff9aefbc94c1631-1280-720.png

从更新看，游戏深度也在继续提升。自 2025 年 4 月 10 日 上线以来，《勇闯死人谷：暗黑之日》基于玩家反馈持续优化丧尸围城下的生存体验。游戏不断扩充丧尸类型并优化枪械系统，加入难度分级、关系系统与存档功能，同时持续拓展新地图内容，两位华人角色也加入了这支在废墟中前行的幸存者队伍。到了 2026 年，随着技能树与交易系统完善，“外出搜刮—对抗丧尸—回撤整备—角色成长” 构成了完整的末日生存体验。
如果你喜欢一款融合末日丧尸战斗、资源管理与生存决策的生存游戏，《勇闯死人谷：暗黑之日》非常值得现场体验。现场试玩可参与周边领取。已购买游戏的玩家，在展位购买限量周边可享玩家专属折扣。
https://image.gcores.com/effec1f19aa2046d830b8efb5fecad9c-1280-720.JPEG
STEAM商店链接
《电车炫客》
《电车炫客》是一款将高速跑酷、平台动作与竞分挑战融为一体的风格化作品，由Undercoders开发。在色彩浓烈的反乌托邦世界里，轨道就是战场。游戏已于2026年7月15日正式发售，并获得IGN 9 分评价。
https://image.gcores.com/723437b49cd770a1c757d336e1c88d9b-1232-706.JPEG
你可以定制专属电车，在城市、草原、火山与海洋之间不断穿梭；也会在旅途中遭遇帮派对抗与高压 Boss 战。 这是一款“上手即爽、精通极深”的动作作品，从机甲魔法少女到移动城堡、从机械蠕虫到电车炫客军团，每一场Boss战都不断升级，在高速变化的轨道战场中考验你技巧与操作的上限。
https://image.gcores.com/d7f74d9505ba175e8c512e6ab00c6d54-1280-720.png
《电车炫客》的魅力，不只在于“能通关”，更在于“如何通关”。你会逐渐学会跟上电车的节奏，记住每段轨道的方向，把一次次失误磨成手感，把一次次冲刺变成风格。最终，你不只是抵达终点，而是把整段旅程跑成一场属于你的炫技表演。
https://image.gcores.com/00484f45d3667c0869dadcd39e79db03-1280-720.png
无论你是第一次上手的新玩家，还是追求极限的动作老手，都能在这里找到属于自己的速度。现场试玩参与高分冲榜与连段挑战，有机会解锁限定周边，领取 3D 打印电车钥匙扣。如果你愿意，就来试试把“电车”开成“传说”。

《这龙带刀》
《这龙带刀》是一款由独立制作人Jean Nguyen打造的史前题材的高强度动作 RPG，融合魂系硬核战斗与开放世界探索。游戏已于 2026 年 7 月 24 日正式登陆Steam。
你将扮演一头年轻的棘龙，挥舞远古巨剑，与装备残酷武器的强敌恐龙展开激战。你可以独自在灭绝边缘磨砺本能，亲手决定族群的最终命运。
某一天，一场远古浩劫撕裂世界，彻底重新定义了恐龙的存在方式。从干涸峡谷到浓雾密林，每一片生态区域都由一头凶残的 Alpha 顶级掠食者统治。一个足以拯救或毁灭一切的古老谜团，正深埋于这场灭绝旋涡的核心。年轻的棘龙握紧巨剑，为守护全族踏入这片野蛮未知之地。
你可以掌握全新技能，衔接高伤害连招，并在精准的闪避、翻滚与招架中体验极具压迫感的即时战斗。将传说级武器、远古精华附加到记忆般的战斗技艺上，自由构筑独特流派。毁灭型的重装巨兽流？高敏捷的撕裂出血流？一切皆有可能！

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610120936105199.png
据数据分析机构Alinea Analytics统计，《极限竞速：地平线6》目前在Steam、Xbox以及PlayStation平台的高级版游戏收入预计已达到5.343亿美元（约合人民币36亿元），位列2026年高级游戏收入排行榜第三名。

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610120936203812.png
《极限竞速：地平线6》此前也获得了媒体高度评价，IGN为本作打出了10分满分评价，称赞游戏拥有更加丰富的开放世界、出色的技术表现以及优秀的流程设计，并认为该作代表了开放世界赛车游戏的新标准。

随着PS5版本即将上线，《极限竞速：地平线6》能否进一步扩大玩家规模，并冲击更高的商业成绩，仍值得关注。

items.title: 《街霸》真人电影招牌必杀全还原!期待春丽一字马回旋
items.summary: 《街霸》真人电影招牌必杀全还原！期待春丽一字马

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610120923134782.png
即将上映的《街头霸王》真人电影近日公开了动作设计方面的幕后细节。饰演肯的演员诺亚·琴蒂内奥透露，为了尽可能还原原作的格斗风格，影片动作指导约翰·瓦莱拉对系列角色及其招牌招式进行了大量研究，力求让每场战斗都保留游戏独有的特色。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610120923402139.png
《街头霸王》系列拥有超过150名角色，每个人物都有不同的背景、战斗方式和标志性技能。面对如此庞大的角色阵容，动作团队需要针对参战人物分别设计格斗编排，确保他们在电影中依然能够展现出各自鲜明的风格，而不是打成千篇一律的普通动作戏。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610120923285249.png
琴蒂内奥在接受GamesRadar+采访时表示，电影会保留游戏中的经典招式，让角色以玩家熟悉的方式展开对决。他特别强调，制作团队对细节的要求相当严格，希望影片中的人物不仅外形符合原作，战斗表现也能让系列粉丝感到亲切。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610120923472143.png
不过，将游戏中的招式搬到真人电影并不容易。部分技能在现实中几乎无法直接实现，制作团队必须在视觉效果与动作可信度之间取得平衡。例如隆的招牌招式“波动拳”，以及春丽的回旋鹤脚蹴，都需要通过动作编排和特效配合，才能既保留原作的辨识度，又让画面看起来足够有冲击力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610120923489526.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610120923493473.jpg

items.summary: 《影之刃零》是一款由灵游坊制作并发行的国产武侠动作游戏，即将于10月29日正式发售，登陆PC/PS5平台。

content.v: 《影之刃零》是一款由灵游坊制作并发行的国产武侠动作游戏，即将于10月29日正式发售，登陆PC/PS5平台。
近日，游戏制作人“Soulframe”梁其伟在接受韩媒Inven采访时谈及了本作开发的困难之处，并表示游戏从精神层面上属于一款独立游戏。
Inven问道：“《影之刃零》对灵游坊来说是一次规模上的巨大挑战。从转向AAA主机游戏的角度来看，最困难的地方是什么？”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610120918544672.jpg
对此，梁其伟回复表示：“此前，我们一直只开发手游，而使用虚幻5开发如此大规模的3D AAA游戏，对我们来说还是第一次。不过，这个IP本身从我还是学生的时候就开始打磨了，至今已有20多年。从那时起，我们就开始构建故事和世界观，并一直延续至今。可以说，只是项目的规模发生了变化。”
“不过，当时中国很少有开发者拥有制作这类游戏的经验，因此我们不得不从头开始构建一切。幸运的是，中国有许多外包工作室，长期以来一直为欧美和日本的工作室提供动画、3D建模、概念艺术等方面的服务，我们也得到了这些工作室的帮助。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/12/small_202610120919003514.jpg
“如果你问我最困难的是什么，我想说，一切都很困难。所有事情对我们来说都是全新的，为了实现自己想要的效果，我们必须用新的方式寻找解决方案。我们甚至聘用了一些非常年轻的开发者，其中有些人刚从学校毕业，也有些人完全没有参与过如此大规模项目的经验，但我们依然将最终Boss、游戏开场等重要内容交给他们负责。”
“也有人会问，《影之刃零》是否属于独立游戏。单从规模来看，很难将它称为独立游戏，这个项目的预算也相当庞大。但从精神层面来说，我认为它是一款独立游戏。因为我们始终努力保持独立游戏的精神，勇于挑战新颖且极具突破性的事物，不害怕打破现有的界限。我认为，正是这种精神在让这款游戏成为现实的过程中发挥了重要作用。”

items.title: 无缝着陆模组看起来将使 Starfield 更接近无人深空
items.summary: Or Star Wars Outlaws, if you're nasty.

content.v: There are mods for Seamless Grav Jumps and for Seamless Planet Takeoffs . But when you arrive at a planet in Starfield you still have to choose a landing spot, and then watch a loading screen and an animation. It's another thing that contributes to the feeling your spaceship is more like a house that can teleport.

When you're in space, Starfield's planets are basically just textures you can fly right through if you put in the hours to try it, as Alanah Pearce discovered back when the RPG's boundaries were still being explored. It seemed like one gap modders would never be able to paper over, but Frederik Wessberg has apparently managed it.

The video of his work-in-progress mod shows a planetary approach, complete with heating effects on the ship during atmospheric entry, a moment of white as he hits a layer of clouds, and then the ship just lands. It seems like the clouds are there to mask a moment of loading, but Wessberg says "the cloud cover is in fact not a fancy loading screen."

He goes on to explain, "The clouds are not covering loading – they're helping make the seam as minimal as possible right at the point when we do the final cell switch, in terms of lighting and exposure, and terrain color. For airless moons and planets, I just do the switch with no veil, which is fine in that context as the lighting and exposure won't change as much between the two cells (although there I do some extra exposure matching). The underlying loading mechanism is entirely done in the background, while the game is still interactive. We just wait until the assets are finished loading in, and then we do the swap."

To make that work, the floating textures had to be replaced with actual models of the planets and moons. "I had to completely reimplement Starfield's planet rendering in space in 3D," Wessberg says, "in a way that looks detailed and sharp at every altitude.

"Thankfully, Starfield is actually amazingly physically accurate, and in many ways a true space simulator – it just doesn't ever reveal this to the player, but I could leverage it in my design here. So, the planet rendering is based upon Starfield's biome data and exact surface maps, including climate data, atmospheric composition data, and takes into account things like orbital phase, distance to the sun, distance to the moon(s) orbiting the planet and how they contribute moonlight, and so on. The philosophy is: Starfield's data is the 'truth', but we then modulate it by real physics."

The finished version of the mod, which will be freely available on Nexus Mods, will let players fly manually in low orbit, or turn on the autopilot and walk around the ship as you descend from orbit, and land anywhere you like—even on water. There's a post on Wessberg's Patreon with the details.

content.v: 由11位工作室携手知名恐怖游戏开发者，Harvester Games 的 雷姆·米哈尔斯基（Rem Michalski） 打造的全新作品《铁道人》将于2027年3月10日正式登陆 PC Steam 平台。在《铁道人》中，你将扮演特洛伊——一名新上任的铁路道口工，独自驻守在荒无人烟的偏僻铁路旁。你的目标看似简单：完成为期一个月的工作合同，同时努力戒酒，并最后一次尝试挽回妻子的信任。来到这座远离尘嚣的塔楼，陪伴特洛伊度过这段艰难的时光，帮助他重拾人生。但请小心，一个月的时间并不短，而这里发生的一切只会变得越来越诡异……
https://image.gcores.com/456830d41cb05394d697276a9905834d-1582-890.jpeg
凭借《Lorelai》《The Cat Lady》和《伯恩豪斯巷》等广受好评的独立恐怖游戏作品，米哈尔斯基早已在恐怖游戏领域享有盛誉。如今，他将自己标志性的恐怖氛围与引人入胜、成熟深刻的叙事风格带入《铁道人》，为玩家呈现一段全新的心理恐怖体验。
「《铁道人》可能是我迄今为止玩法机制最为丰富的一部作品，但心理恐怖的核心依然贯穿始终，构成了整个游戏的基调」。独自开发《铁道人》的雷姆·米哈尔斯基表示，「与直白的暴力场面和突如其来的惊吓不同，这是一种更加细腻、含蓄的恐怖。它源于令人不安的体验、压抑得令人窒息的环境，以及人性深处难以愈合的心理创伤」。
https://image.gcores.com/fad2494805d7cb9877c494b188b952c0-1920-1080.jpg
在《铁道人》中，你需要熟记列车时刻表，及时升降道口栏杆，体验争分夺秒的紧张感。与此同时，你还得时刻关注自己的饥饿值，保证充足的睡眠，甚至每次上完厕所都要记得洗手，以免生病。随着游戏的推进，你将逐步解锁新的技能与能力，同时也会被一步步引向笼罩着塔楼的重重迷雾之中。
https://image.gcores.com/ca9fa4abe38d9e34046b47d7b449bf69-1920-1080.jpg
陌生人前来寻求帮助，或只是想找人聊聊天；驶来的列车捎来神秘的信息，而周围发生的一切也变得愈发诡异。但请记住，时间从不等人：一天只有那么多时间，你不可能追查每一条线索，也无法兑现每一个承诺。
如果你想在短短一个月内重拾人生，就必须学会分清轻重缓急，做出取舍，并懂得适时放手。
《铁道人》特色：
做好你的工作：查看时刻表。放下栏杆，目送列车驶过，再将栏杆升起。道口看守员的工作简单、重复，甚至近乎乏味——直到每一件杂务、每一通诡异的电话，以及每一次踏入迷雾，都让你开始怀疑什么才是真正重要的。熟悉日常流程，遵守时间安排，但最重要的是，别忘了兑现承诺：每天都要给妻子打电话。
跟随迷雾：这片荒无人烟之地，并不只有一座孤零零的岗楼。越过铁道口，你会遇见古怪的邻居，发现上锁的地点、古老的小径，以及那些本不该被你知晓的秘密。特洛伊越是深入，这个世界就越像是在将他一点点吞噬，而回头的路也愈发遥远。
https://image.gcores.com/1b0588535c2101d827f53cb90f728cf3-1920-1080.jpg
https://image.gcores.com/44b504ebafeaec1ea1210588bcb39ee7-1920-1080.jpg
别让自己垮掉：让特洛伊吃饱、休息好、保持清洁，也别让他的精神状态失控。饥饿、疲惫、恐惧与疏于照顾自己都会一点点将他拖垮，而每一次错过与阿加莎的通话，也都会让接下来的这个月变得更加难熬。保持清醒、远离酒精，并不是上岗第一天许下承诺就够了。在一班又一班列车、永远做不完的杂务，以及外面那些未知之物的夹缝之间，特洛伊必须日复一日地为此努力。
学会放手：这一个月不会等你做好准备。列车会准时驶来，阿加莎会打来电话，陌生人会向你寻求帮助，而迷雾也总会给你另一个离开岗位、走出去的理由。你不可能追查每一条线索、兑现每一个承诺，也无法让每一天都完美无缺。你必须决定此刻什么最重要，什么可以错过——以及当不得不有所舍弃时，特洛伊最终会成为一个怎样的人。

items.title: PvP 弹球真是个好主意，我不敢相信我以前没有玩过它
items.summary: Bumper Bout has a demo on Steam right now.

content.v: One of the great things about videogame conventions is there are always people up for playing a local multiplayer game, just waiting to be handed controls and thrown into a new experience. Which is how, at PAX Australia over the weekend, I found myself playing a game called Bumper Bout. It immediately impressed me with its concept, and then as I played a few rounds of it, with how it executed that concept.

Bumper Bout is two-player competitive pinball. If you know Puyo Puyo Tetris it's like that, but if you don't then imagine you're playing pinball on one half of the screen while someone else beside you is doing the same, only with the ability to flick balls across the divide. While you're trying to land a skill shot or just frantically deal with the balls already pinging between your flippers, the neighbor casually lobs another problem over the fence and says, "Deal with this. Good luck!"

Bumper Bout had the honor of being chosen as the final game of the Omegathon, the main stage tournament that plays out over the course of PAX, where it was introduced as a game made by someone who thought, "I love pinball, but no one ever dies."

Every time a ball goes down the ballhole you lose a heart, and the first player to lose five hearts loses the round. But scoring points by hitting bumpers and targets earns attack balls that you can zip over to harass your opponent, or store until you get four of them, unlocking your character's ultimate ability—which might let you create a gravity well or, if you're playing the pirate, throw bombs around the already hectic playfield.

Those playfields include a space level where satellites and moons bounce into each other to make even more chaos, and a foosball table where the flippers also activate half the player standees so you can use them to flick balls around as well. It takes a lot to overcome the noise and overwhelm of a busy show floor, but while I was playing Bumper Bout I was fully locked in.

I've seen plenty of demos that are popular at conventions fail to translate that popularity to the final release, but I hope that Bumper Bout can manage it. It's got singleplayer, with arcade and survival modes planned, and the final version will have online multiplayer too. You can try the demo for yourself on Steam , and the full game will be out on October 29.

items.title: Yahtzee 仍然对电子游戏很刻薄，这对他有好处
items.summary: Zero Punctuation was an essential watch back in the day. Its successor Fully Ramblomatic still carries the tor

content.v: When the HMS Escapist sank everyone worth a damn swam away to form a YouTube channel called Second Wind , where Yahtzee Croshaw's video series Zero Punctuation continued under the name Fully Ramblomatic. It's not exactly the same—the people have glasses now—but it's continuing the essential work of being rude about videogames on the internet.

Back in the Before Times, when someone brought a videogame magazine to school we'd all gather round to flick through it, and the only measure of whether it was a good videogame magazine was if the captions on the screenshots were funny. I didn't notice until years later, but that meant we only read the British ones.

That particularly British tone is something Yahtzee's videos share. It might come across as flippant to some, but to me it's always read as deep care. Putting in the effort to make a description witty instead of plain means you're working harder to keep your audience engaged, and doing that for videogames suggests you care enough about them to want your audience to actually pay attention.

Yahtzee does that. Like Blackadder finding the 100th way to tell Baldrick he's an idiot, he never runs out of ways to complain about videogames. You know how Palworld made a big deal about letting you give your Fauxkémon guns? As Yahtzee points out, to actually do that in the game you have to "jump through so many hoops you feel like a spider in a bowl of Cheerios." That's a throwaway description I bet took the better part of the afternoon, and every episode is full of them.

When he actually likes something about a game it stands out. Not just because each tiny liferaft of positivity floats on the storm-tossed ocean of his negativity, but because his praise is as well-observed as his critique. When he says the turn-based combat of South Park: The Stick of Truth gives it a pacing that leaves natural gaps for jokes to fit in, that observation deepens your understanding of the game.

The internet's full of cynicism now, and I understand why people wouldn't be interested in more of it. But the videogame industry deserves to be disrespected every now and then, and videos that don't even bother to show a screenshot because contempt can be communicated just as well via stock images and a recurring catalogue of weird little guys are the kind of disrespect I can get behind.
I mean, he's wrong about Knights of the Old Republic , but I'll forgive him that one.

content.v: 近日开发者JonathanDC64推出FFCCEOT-Recomp项目，让Nintendo DS游戏《最终幻想水晶编年史：时之回响》通过静态重编译在PC上原生运行。项目将原版ARM机器码转换为C语言源码，再针对目标设备编译，运行方式有别于硬件模拟。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261012/1791754990_871060_jpg_r.jpg
项目仓库不包含游戏代码、纹理或音频等受版权保护的内容。首次启动时，用户须提供自己的美版或欧版卡带镜像；程序会进行SHA-1校验，并在本地生成运行所需文件。
图形部分改用OpenGL，支持提高渲染分辨率、宽屏显示、画面处理选项，以及通过插帧提高显示帧率。原作的双屏画面可改为画中画、并排、上下排列或独立窗口，操作也适配手柄和键盘。
0.2.0-alpha版本增加了对欧版游戏德语、法语和西班牙语的支持，并可通过Kaeru WFC、WiiLink WFC等替代服务器联机。Windows版还支持在同一台电脑上运行两个实例，进行本地连接。
项目仍处于早期测试阶段。开发者目前仅对开场区域的稳定性给出保证，欧版联机也出现过偶发崩溃。

Call of Duty fans are torn about NetEase Games' ECC: Redline, a new FPS that many have called a "rip-off" with the power to fill the void for frustrated Warzone players.

NetEase called its new shooter a "self-developed extreme-sports tactical shooter" when revealing it just days ago. It's yet another big swing from the China-based tech company that boasts breakneck gameplay on PC via Steam and mobile devices, but in the hours since its big debut, it's also been called a "1:1 rip" of Activision's Call of Duty: Warzone, and it's not too hard to see why.

Viewers say guns look, kick, and move in a way that seems familiar, but the similarities don't stop there. Everything down the UI is being investigated by FPS enjoyers, too, with things like the sound effects also evoking the same kind of gritty action Call of Duty is known for. Even the way the first-person camera blurs when dropping from heights might feel familiar to fans of Warzone and other shooters. Even with characters that present their own unique abilities and gadgets, ECC: Redline has had a hard time escaping the comparisons online.

items.title: 《尼尔》创始人横尾太郎表示，他已经实现了职业梦想，但他仍在继续工作，因为这“有助于预防痴呆症”
items.summary: "With Drakengard, the first game I was given the opportunity to direct, I was actually able to do almost every

content.v: They say that art is never finished, only abandoned—but that doesn't seem to be the case for Yoko Taro, creator of Nier and Drakengard, who you might recognize by the round, smiley Emil mask he wears. According to a report from Denfaminicogamer (via IGN ), Taro said at the Tokyo French Institute last month that he's already more or less realized his vision and has considered retiring.

"With Drakengard, the first game I was given the opportunity to direct, I was actually able to do almost everything the way I wanted," Taro said. "As a game otaku, I think the dream is to release something you've always wanted to create into the world. Having achieved that dream, I view everything after that as the remainder of my life."

As for why he continues to work in gamedev if he's already achieved his dreams, well, he said the money doesn't hurt—and that he has a fear of how his mental health might degrade should he grow idle. "This is good for preventing dementia," he said.

It's worth noting that Taro is, to put it in technical terms, a bit of a silly goose, if the mask didn't tip you off. As the IGN report notes, it's possible he doesn't literally mean that he only works in gamedev to stave off dementia. But that sentiment, as well as his saying that he hopes he can dodge the "flames" of competition from younger, AI-assisted generations before he dies, speak to how Taro views his place in the games industry.

"I've always worked in the games industry with the mindset of 'filling in the gaps.' I really like games like Ico and Ikaruga, but when I played them they were so perfect that I thought, 'I don't need to make games in these genres,'" he said.

"That's not jealousy, it's the feeling of, 'This gap has already been filled, so I need to fill a different one.' I think the reason that my games are crude games full of terrible things is because the pioneers have already seized all the beautiful aspects."

items.title: Arc Raiders 2.0 来了，你终于可以关掉背包上的灯了
items.summary: Just because I'm sneaking around doesn't mean I don't want to look my best.

content.v: I remember being a kid and wishing I had shoes that lit up. I know now that I was a fool. If I festooned myself with garish lights, how would I scavenge for supplies in a frozen wasteland without being spotted by strangers who may or may not kill me before I can use my grappling hook to get away? This isn't a real problem I have, nor is it a real problem Arc Raiders players will have anymore, since your backpack now has an emissive toggle.

That's one of many little overhauls that arrived in Embark Studios' popular extraction shooter Thursday, and you can read all about the rest in the 2.0 patch notes . If you've not been tuned into the extraction world as of late, you did indeed read that right: Arc Raiders has gotten a big shakeup with the Frozen Trails update , which comes bearing snowy mountains and grappling hooks.

But that's not what's exciting about patch notes—the best part of combing through each little bullet point is seeing all those long-awaited bug fixes and little quality-of-life changes like the aforementioned emissive toggle for backpacks. That and tidbits like "added mouth animation for when players are talking in proximity chat," which I can only hope looks as silly in-game as it does in my imagination.

Some other big, but also small changes include the fact that you can open the map when you're downed now, new contextual animations for a variety of things (your character should look more exhausted when sprinting for a while), and an increased max stash size: 328 without expedition bonuses.

Snowy and desolate as it might look, Arc Raiders seems to be picking up momentum with the new update. Its average player count has gone way up recently, probably due to the free weekend that's going on right now, so it seems like as good a time as any to dive back in if you're so inclined. If that's you, try out our guides on how to arc raid with the best of 'em.

Bandai Namco has revealed a first look at Tekken 8 DLC character Yujiro Hanma, and the Baki rep is looking just as uncanny as fans expected.

The new trailer for the fighting game's Season 3 characters debuted alongside Evo France 2026. Following Kunimitsu's release in June and Bob's release in August, kangaroo-and-joey fighter Roger Jr. is now officially set for a November 11 early access launch, with the full release following November 16, but the character most fans are looking forward to is still without a proper release date.

Roger Jr. is definitely the star of the new Tekken 8 DLC trailer, with nearly three minutes of its four-minute runtime dedicated to showing off the marsupial boxer's gameplay. The Yujiro teaser, meanwhile, is tucked at the end, but its reveals are particularly shocking. You can see how the Baki the Grappler villain has been reimagined within the world of Tekken below.

Yujiro is… expressive, to say the least, so nailing his face and bulging muscles was always going to draw attention. Well, the Bandai Namco team did their best, with today's Evo trailer showing just a few shots of his iconic toothy smile and flexibility.

It looks like work on the anime guest character is still underway, but just because there's no release date doesn't mean there isn't a plan to show more. The end of the new teaser promised that a new Yujiro trailer will premiere alongside the Tekken World Tour Finals January 17, 2027. That's three months out from now, so we can probably expect to see gameplay by that point.

Looking back at the calendar, Bandai Namco has typically had a few months of downtime between Tekken 8 DLC releases. It will have been two months since Roger Jr. was released when the Yujiro trailer is shared, meaning we can also expect a release date announcement around that time, too. If we're lucky, the Baki fighter might even drop that same day, but again, nothing regarding his release date has been confirmed quite yet.

Roger Jr. and Yujiro are both included in the Season 3 pass and will round out its promise of four bonus characters. Season 1 and Season 2 included fighters like Heihachi, Armor King, Anna, and Final Fantasy 16 protagonist Clive Rosfield. While passes cost $30 each, the Season 3 pass is currently available for $34.99.

IGN learned more about Yujiro's inclusion in Tekken 8 when speaking with producer Naoya Yasuda and director of promotions and former Baki manga editor Yuki Yokoi earlier this year. Be sure to read the full interview for insight into how and why the team decided to include a character that never loses. You can also read about how former Tekken director Katsuhiro Harada influenced one of Roger Jr.'s best references , and the player who climbed through the ranks while blindfolded .

items.summary: I just can't relate to these capable heroes.

Welcome to Dungeon Master , PC Gamer's regular RPG column, where Online Editor Fraser Brown delves into PC gaming's most beloved and enduring genre. Grab a seat in our badly-lit tavern and please ignore the goblin puke.

Most videogame RPGs are selling a power fantasy—the idea that you are competent, clever and regardless of the odds will still manage to save the day. Fate has made you a hero, and nothing is going to stop you from achieving your goals. And this holds a lot of appeal. It's sometimes nice to be able to take a holiday from my own incompetence.

Over the last few days I've managed to drop my dinner, get trapped on a bus going in the wrong direction, get peed on by a dog, get almost run over by a car and, to top it all off, actually get knocked over by an electric scooter. I am a walking disaster.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/2vosCrtmSKYbUJUok6jBsQ-1920-80.jpg

Geralt never gets peed on. Shepard never lands on their arse after colliding with a teen. These are not heroic moments. When these protagonists face adversity, it only serves as an excuse for more badass adventures.

It turns out, though, that constantly winning becomes a little dull. I want more friction. More fuck ups. But games, by and large, want you to succeed, even when they throw obstacles in your way. Last month, I wrote about how The Blood of Dawnwalker sets up all these possible ways for you to fail, only to then make it almost impossible to screw up unless you're really trying. But it's hardly alone in this regard.

But this problem is not inherent to all RPGs—it's certainly not present in TTRPGs, which tend to embrace misfortune. Many of them actually thrive on it, like Mothership and Call of Cthulhu. And it was only when I started to play TTRPGs that I really began to appreciate how much fun it is to not be the Chosen One, to just be some guy who, either through cursed rolls or bad calls, keeps messing up.
Idiots have more fun
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/HhvX4bSWjWvHtjM2LoGdqb-1920-80.jpg

Being asked to do a thing, doing the thing, and then getting congratulated for it—that's not a particularly good anecdote. If, in the process of completing your quest, you get outsmarted by some children, throw up all over yourself, break your foot and end up disappointing everyone around you, well, then you've got a great story.

Thankfully, more and more RPGs are celebrating idiots. Not that it's a new concept. I vividly recall the shock I got when, after a series of questionable decisions in Baldur's Gate 2, my stoic pal Jaheira decided that I was so rotten, so beyond hope, that the only solution was to kill me.

It's absolutely more prevalent now, however, as CRPGs have started leaning into their TTRPG roots in more dramatic ways. Baldur's Gate 3 is still a power fantasy, but it's one driven by dice rolls, where failure is always nipping at your heels. Play the Dark Urge and you'll even start accidentally murdering people.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hz55CyKqU2gncAeD84DVvE-1920-80.png

Disco Elysium is, of course, the RPG that most embraces the idea that it's fun to be shit. Even if you're the luckiest player in the world, nailing every roll, you can still simply choose to be a big dumb weirdo. I base most of my decisions on how funny I think the writing is going to be, which is how I ended up a communist paranormal investigator constantly going on rants about the apocalypse.
When failure is almost guaranteed, it makes succeeding so much more impressive.

Zero Parades and Esoteric Ebb have followed suit—two games where every interaction offers you the tantalising prospect of making a complete tit out of yourself. In the former, I managed to have a full-on breakdown during a phone call in the first five minutes. In the latter, I largely ignored my quest to solve an act of terrorism to instead focus all of my energy on winning an election where I was not a candidate.

What I find so endlessly compelling about these kinds of RPGs is not necessarily the constant cock ups, though. It's more that they offer up a ridiculous breadth of options, making me feel like anything could happen. You can pick the most ridiculous actions or dialogue choices, and there's still the chance that you'll nail them, pulling off something seemingly impossible. When failure is almost guaranteed, it makes succeeding so much more impressive.
Critical fail
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/yDSiHxg3rRBdUFukFttV6H-1920-80.jpg

And if you do mess up, or more likely when, it feels like you're getting more story, more interesting consequences. How a game handles failure is so important. If it gives you all these ways to get it wrong, but then simply punishes or kills you, it implies that there's only really one right way to do things—you're either a flawless hero or you're dead.

I recall a quest in Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 where I had to set up a tournament between two swordfighting schools, which involved a bit of larceny. I got caught, became embroiled in a Benny Hill-style chase, and while I managed to get out with the stolen goods, nobody could really call it a success. The result? Everyone knew I did the crime. The tournament went forward, but my team was given a serious handicap. When we won, it felt so much more meaningful because my actions had turned us into the underdogs.

Good roleplaying is essentially improv. What you want is a permissive GM (whether it's a literal GM or a videogame's systems) who's down for a bit of "Yes, and," who will let you come up with a dumb solution and try to find interesting outcomes even if you fail miserably. This way, the storytelling becomes truly collaborative, full of texture and surprises, rather than yet another rote hero's journey.
